scope: Selected-part printing, geometric automatic orientation, multiple plates, manual XYZ and precise motion-link editing
tested_behaviors: Actual part checklist, current selection and clear selection
Bolt and nut exclusion preserves washers and pins; reasons remain visible
Multiple print plates, switching, manual movement and XYZ rotation
Actual VTK ray picking and Qt drag placement
Current-plate STL and all-plate ZIP with relative index and exact selected identities
STL bounds, dimensions and bottom Z=0
Oversized whole body and overlap warnings block affected output
Stale settings and changed save-picker state do not export an obsolete preview
Save-picker and mid-export cancellation preserve source history and prior output bytes
Exact motion-link editing, enabled invalid-limit blocking, Undo/Redo and Save As/reopen
Bounded real surface normals, areas and heights compare axial and oblique face orientation candidates
Estimated support-demand reduction on an actual asymmetric shape, geometric contact/center-of-mass stability and exact bed fit
Explicit automatic operation updates selected poses and repacks plates; ordinary refresh preserves subsequent manual edits
Recommendation metrics retain provenance after manual overrides or changed bed settings
Changed controls, cancellation and recommendation failure preserve source and manual poses without stale export

visual_evidence.printing: Six genuine VTK framebuffers and six separately composited Qt-control captures per completed print run
root_direct_inspection: Source automatic recommendation and estimated metrics
visual_evidence.motion: Raw Qt controls and reopened timeline; WGL black area is not geometry proof

preserved_initial_failure: First source QA clicked outside the checkbox indicator/text; 43 checks completed before failure. The fixture click was corrected without weakening stale-preview guards.
corrected_product_issue: ZIP completion shows the selected output path rather than the returned index dictionary.
limitations: Eight synthetic printing parts including a real imported BREP, plus a separate three-body motion fixture
No physical printer output, hardware strength, firmware target, load rating or tolerance qualification
Large individual bodies remain whole; splitting is across print plates
Support, infill, layers and G-code are configured in an external slicer
Name hints are unverified selection aids; unknown fastener identity stays user-controlled
Historical full2442 source tests belong to v3.0.1, not a fresh v3.1.0 full run
Support area-height proxy is not ray-traced or actual slicer support volume
Uniform-density geometric center of mass and convex near-bed footprint do not model adhesion, real material, layer strength or actual printer success
Native build and tessellation cannot cancel mid-call; bounded work and cancellation are checked before and after each native operation

orientation_method.stability_basis: convex_hull_of_near_bed_surface; no adhesion or dynamic-load model
orientation_method.qualification: 표면 면적×바닥 높이와 접촉·무게중심 추정입니다. 실제 서포트 체적·슬라이싱·출력 성공을 보장하지 않습니다.

preserved_orientation_fixture_failure: The first cylinder test expected a physically incorrect tenfold contact-area ratio for a finite 0.1 mm contact band. The metric was unchanged; finite-band and flat-end support/stability assertions were corrected and all 64 current core cases passed.

preserved_final1_installed_failure.failed_check: Actual keyboard edit reaches the numeric control
